changelog: Fixes a disk-space leak in Factory Reset: run_factory_reset() never called the same release-pruning logic run_update() already uses on success, and never cleaned up a failed attempt's partial staging directory either - so every factory reset attempt (successful or failed) left a full copy of the release tree behind permanently. Both are now cleaned up: successful resets prune old releases the same way regular updates do, and a failed attempt removes its own orphaned staging directory immediately. Note: this fix lives in run_update.py, which is deployed separately from app releases (same as device_identity.py) - installing this update will NOT pick it up; it must be copied to /opt/pinclock/updater/run_update.py manually. Also includes all v0.15.4 changes (factory-reset auto-reload fix) and v0.15.3 changes (labwc permission fix, broader exception handling).
